# MagnusBilling 7

Official AI-ready documentation index for LLMs, coding agents, and RAG systems.

Project: MagnusBilling 7 (VoIP billing platform for Asterisk)
Repository: https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7
Primary branch/docs path: https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7/tree/source

## Start Here (High Priority)

- https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7/blob/source/ia-docs/README.md - AI docs overview, retrieval policy, ingestion order.
- https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7/blob/source/ia-docs/playbooks/qa_protocol.md - Answer protocol and evidence-first response format.
- https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7/blob/source/ia-docs/playbooks/question_routing.md - Intent/domain routing guidance.
- https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7/blob/source/ia-docs/indexes/rag_manifest.json - Canonical machine manifest of IA docs corpus.

## Source Priority Policy

1. Current repository code is authoritative.
2. IA domain/playbook docs provide curated operational guidance.
3. Video transcript-derived docs are contextual support.
4. If sources conflict, prefer current code behavior.

## Discovery Keywords

MagnusBilling, Asterisk, VoIP billing, Yii framework, ExtJS, AGI, DID, IVR, queue,
SIP, CDR, rate tables, trunk, provider costs, refill, invoices, call center.
